Examples.Title: Check that a face can be used
Examples.Description: A face can be used by the account that created it, and, when it is public, by any account that has its face ID. Public faces are not discoverable: no endpoint lists or searches other accounts' faces, so another account can use a public face only if it has been given the ID.
Examples.Code:
### Check that a face can be used
GET {{host}}/face/{{id}}
x-simli-api-key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: The face is yours or public
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Invalid input
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized
# 403
# Description: The face is neither yours nor public
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: No such face
# Content-Type: application/json
